submissions.note: THE TOP PRESET. Fresh ledger, its own three secured vein-hunter claims behind it, rung 3 earned the same way. Vein Hunter is +11% enemy hp and -25% xp per kill against Trail, so the hero levels slower and the works have to carry more of the run — which makes the placement contract the whole game. Every cell here is one I watched a building stand on this morning on this exact map: (-8,7), (-2,-7), (7,7) took turrets and (-5,7) took a beacon. All four turrets go on proven ground, spaced >=3.0wu (turret+turret needs >2.4). The one unproven cell is the cheap beacon at (2,-7), 4.0 clear of the turret at (-2,-7) and 3.5 from the seam site at (-1.5,-6.4) — 25 gold is the right price for an experiment. Wave triggers only, two apart, each clearing its own cost; the 125 rung gets wave 9 and the fullest purse of the run because it is the order that has died three times today.
HOLD. The failed turret did not consume the bench count, so the wave-9 order now prices at 95 rather than 125 — the ladder self-corrects and needs no re-command.
